# Management change — NiftyTotalMarket

*Run 2026-11-26 · window 2025-11-26 → 2026-11-26 · 752 companies · judge: claude-opus-5 read each candidate company's complete documents.*

Two kinds of management change: the **promoters / owners** of the company changing, and the **CEO / MD or CFO** changing. Nothing here rests on a filing's headline: the text of every filing in the management, board and takeover categories was read, along with board outcomes, press releases and updates, NSE's quarterly shareholding register, its Regulation 29 takeover disclosures, bulk and block deals, and the stored conference calls. A reading model then read each candidate company's complete documents and decided; every name and quote it gave was checked against the documents.

| | Count |
|---|---:|
| Companies with a management change | **341** |
| …ownership: change of control, completed | 14 |
| …ownership: change of control, in progress | 2 |
| …ownership: large stake change, same controller | 67 |
| …ownership: within the promoter family / group | 29 |
| …chief executive changes (CEO / MD) | 178 at 157 companies |
| …CFO changes | 218 at 181 companies |
| Filings whose text was read | 39,616 |
| Companies the mechanical read put to the judge | 550 for the seats, 214 for the ownership |
